specs.title: Bundled base-ten blocks

states.name: observe
states.narration: Show 2 tens and 8 ones beside 1 ten and 7 ones

states.name: manipulate
states.narration: Drag 10 of the 15 ones into a new ten bundle

states.name: reflect
states.narration: Display 4 tens and 5 ones = 45

specs.mathematical_invariant: Never change total represented value; exactly 10 ones exchange for 1 ten
specs.misconception_feedback: Forgot to carry? Count ones before and after the trade

accessibility.keyboard: Every drag interaction must have equivalent focusable select/move controls
accessibility.screen_reader: Announce numeric quantities, unit labels, and each completed state
accessibility.reduced_motion: Instant state transitions preserve identical mathematical content
accessibility.color_independence: Use shape, text and numeric labels in addition to color

specs.assessment_prompt: Explain why the interaction for 28 + 17 preserves the mathematical meaning and compute the answer without relying on the animation.
